articles.title: OpenAI to start showing ads on ChatGPT’s free and Go tiers in India
articles.description: OpenAI has more than 100 million weekly active ChatGPT users in India, a huge chunk of whom are on the free or the lower-priced Go tiers.
articles.author: Ivan Mehta

articles.title: Hugging Face is selling a cute $399 open source duck robot, Microduck
articles.description: Clem Delangue, CEO of Hugging Face, said the Microduck is an “open-source robot you can teach new tricks with reinforcement learning.”
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Plaud’s new earphones come with an eSIM-enabled case for talking to AI agents
articles.description: Called Plaud One, these adopt the simple bare-bones style of Apple's AirPods, and can record calls, while their case can be used to record in-person conversations or take notes.
articles.author: Ivan Mehta

articles.title: An Anthropic researcher just gave us a peek at self-improving AI
articles.description: Given 10 benchmarks for specific misaligned behaviors, the automated systems were able to improve performance on every single one without degrading overall performance.
articles.author: Russell Brandom

articles.title: AI’s memory crunch is coming for Android apps
articles.description: Google is setting new memory-use limits for Android apps as AI data centers contribute to hardware shortages that could leave lower-cost phones with less memory.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Amazon just tripled its order of Nvidia chips over ‘surging demand’
articles.description: Amazon is adding another 2 million Nvidia GPU chips to its data centers over the next two years. But this extended partnerships stretches beyond buying more chips.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan, Kirsten Korosec

articles.title: Hugging Face reportedly in talks to be acquired for $13B
articles.description: Hugging Face has reportedly been fielding acquisition offers that would value the company at around $13B. But with the founders' feeling of responsibility to community, doubts arise as to whether a sale will happen.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Hearing tech startup Legato emerges from stealth with $12M and a peek at its AI hearing glasses
articles.description: The glasses, called Legato Frames, integrate the company’s patented hearing-assistance technology into the arms of eyewear frames.
articles.author: Aisha Malik

articles.title: Gamma acquires Accel-backed design startup Lica
articles.description: Lica co-founders are going to work on Gamma's new research team.
articles.author: Ivan Mehta

articles.title: Sony Music, Warner sue Anthropic, alleging a “brazen campaign” of intellectual property theft
articles.description: This latest lawsuit is particularly broad and homes in on accusations of illegal piracy.
articles.author: Kirsten Korosec
